entries.bf5fffa94f419d3f: As its corporate philosophy, under the Sumitomo business spirit of 'Placing importance on trust,' 'Aiming for certainty' and 'Not chasing fleeting profits,' it states that it sincerely supports logistics as social infrastructure and works to create new services that customers and society require. In March 2026, it formalized its purpose, 'Connect, Support, Create the Next Era,' and formulated the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2026-2030' as the final phase of its long-term vision, Moving Forward to 2030. It is pursuing eight growth strategies, including expansion of overseas bases, expansion of the domestic logistics network, creation of high value-added logistics and strengthening of its real estate portfolio, and sets a performance target of consolidated operating revenue of ¥280 billion for fiscal 2030.
